(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } return 'ready ' + !!window.__app + ' ' + (window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState); })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player, v=p.video, view=p.view; v.pause(); v.currentTime=2; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); view.reset(); view.setQuality({ sharpen: 0 }); view.setVignette(0); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=v.videoWidth; c.height=v.videoHeight; const g=c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(v,0,0); const avg=(d)=>{ let r=0,gg=0,b=0,n=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ r+=d[i]; gg+=d[i+1]; b+=d[i+2]; n++; } return [r/n,gg/n,b/n].map(x=>Math.round(x)).join(','); }; const cx=Math.round(c.width/4), cy=Math.round(c.height/2); const src=avg(g.getImageData(cx-2, cy-2, 5, 5).data); const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); view.render(true); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth, H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; const px=new Uint8Array(4*25); gl.readPixels(Math.round(W/2)-2, Math.round(H/2)-2, 5, 5, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, px); return 'source centre ' + src + ' | VR centre ' + avg(px) + ' | mode ' + __app.player.state?.mode; })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player, v=p.video, view=p.view; const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); view.render(true); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth,H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; const d=new Uint8Array(W*H*4); gl.readPixels(0,0,W,H,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,d); let s=0,n=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ s+=0.2126*d[i]+0.7152*d[i+1]+0.0722*d[i+2]; n++; } const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=v.videoWidth/2; c.height=v.videoHeight; const g=c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(v,0,0,v.videoWidth/2,v.videoHeight,0,0,c.width,c.height); const e=g.getImageData(Math.round(c.width*0.3),Math.round(c.height*0.3),Math.round(c.width*0.4),Math.round(c.height*0.4)).data; let s2=0,n2=0; for(let i=0;i<e.length;i+=4){ s2+=0.2126*e[i]+0.7152*e[i+1]+0.0722*e[i+2]; n2++; } return 'VR view mean luma ' + (s/n).toFixed(1) + ' vs source centre region ' + (s2/n2).toFixed(1); })()

(async()=>{ const view=__app.player.view; const f0=view.frames||0; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000)); const f1=view.frames||0; __app.player.video.currentTime=4; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const f2=view.frames||0; return 'paused: ' + (f1-f0) + ' frames drawn in 1 s; after seek: ' + (f2-f1) + ' frame(s)'; })()

(async()=>{ const view=__app.player.view; const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); const grab=()=>{ view.render(true); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth,H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; const d=new Uint8Array(W*H*4); gl.readPixels(0,0,W,H,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,d); let e=0; for(let y=1;y<H-1;y+=2) for(let x=1;x<W-1;x+=2){ const i=(y*W+x)*4; e+=Math.abs(d[i+1]-d[i+5]); } return e; }; view.setQuality({ sharpen: 0 }); const a=grab(); view.setQuality({ sharpen: 1 }); const b=grab(); view.setQuality({ sharpen: 0.25 }); return 'edge energy off ' + a + ' -> full sharpen ' + b + ' (' + ((b/a-1)*100).toFixed(0) + '% more detail)'; })()

(async()=>{ const view=__app.player.view; const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); const edge=()=>{ view.render(true); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth,H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; const d=new Uint8Array(4*W); gl.readPixels(0,Math.round(H/2),W,1,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,d); let s=0; for(let x=0;x<20;x++) s+=d[x*4+1]; return s/20; }; view.setVignette(0); const a=edge(); view.setVignette(1); const b=edge(); view.setVignette(0); return 'edge brightness ' + a.toFixed(0) + ' -> with full vignette ' + b.toFixed(0); })()

(async()=>{ __app.player.view.setCurved(true); __app.player.view.render(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); __app.player.view.setCurved(false); return 'curved toggled without errors'; })()

(async()=>{ __app.player.video.play(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); __app.player.toggleStats(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300)); const t=document.querySelector('.stats-hud')?.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' | '); return t; })()

(async()=>{ __app.player.openCC(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const pop=document.querySelector('.popover'); const row=[...pop.querySelectorAll('span')].find(s=>s.textContent==='Fix wind & hiss'); row.nextElementSibling.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); [...pop.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Night').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const s=await vr180.getSettings(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); return JSON.stringify(s.sound) + ' audio ctx ' + (__app.player.audio?.ctx?.state); })()
(async()=>{ await vr180.setSettings({ sound: { fix: false, level: 'off' } }); return 'reset'; })()
